dedupe_keys.name: ibge logistica dos transportes 2024 brazil freight origin destination flows by road rail waterway and air

description: Logística dos Transportes is a study by the Instituto Brasileiro de Geografia e Estatística (IBGE) of how goods move across Brazil's transport networks; its 2024 edition publishes the underlying freight flow databases. Contents: two sets of files, consolidated freight flows (Fluxos Consolidados de Mercadorias) and detailed origin-destination freight flows (Fluxos Detalhados OD de Mercadorias), each split by mode into road, rail and waterway flows, with air flows in the consolidated set; the road files are the largest (17 MB consolidated, 50 MB detailed, zipped). Earlier IBGE layers of the same series, in the INDE catalogue, estimate annual average daily heavy-vehicle traffic (VMDa) by axle class on each segment of the federal road network from the national traffic counting plan, and an energy logistics series (Logística de Energia 2015) maps transmission lines, pipelines and energy flows. Coverage: Brazil, reference year of the 2024 edition; files posted on 14 July 2026. Format and access: ZIP archives on IBGE's public file server geoftp.ibge.gov.br, with maps and methodology on the IBGE site. Free; licence not stated on the pages read (the IBGE web pages answered the cloud with a bot check, so the methodology was not read). Caveats: the flow units, commodity groups and zoning were not read, since the archives were not opened. Simulation uses: freight demand matrices for multimodal network flow and supply chain models, criticality analysis of corridors and ports. Related records: the DNIT road network base (data-dnit-brazil-sistema-nacional-de-viacao-snv) supplies the road segments.
